sources.title: Axe Compute Q3 2026 Form 10-Q; Notes 4, 8–13, 15, liquidity and Georgia risk factors
Definitive proxy: Nov 6 capitalization and Dec 17 equity-plan vote
Issuer acquisition release: amended five-year Georgia revenue expectation
Issuer release: October 15 inducement option grants
StockAnalysis AGPU: provider-reported November 25 regular-session close

capital_bridge.label: Historical economic common floor
capital_bridge.basis: Calculated 13.634097M issued common + 7.736379M prefunded warrants at $0.01 exercise. Same-date partial economic exposure, not current or fully diluted. Nominal exercise cash is only $77,363.79 before fees; do not count old exercises twice.

capital_bridge.label: Newer legal common count
capital_bridge.value: 13.650314M at November 13; same count at November 6
capital_bridge.basis: Reported 10-Q cover and proxy record date. Increase from September 30 is 16,217 legal common shares; unverified mix of exercises/other issuance. Cannot automatically add old prefunded balance to this newer legal count.

capital_bridge.label: Options: reconciled post-quarter bridge
capital_bridge.basis: Q3 Note12: 1.322883M options weighted strike $6.50. October15 inducement grants +0.100000M at $8.60 reconcile numerically to proxy total 1.422883M weighted strike $6.64. New grants vest over three years; not immediate common. Proxy award aggregate/components must not be added twice.

capital_bridge.label: Other securities and proposed awards
capital_bridge.value: 1.592749M other warrants; 79,246 Series B preferred; +2M proposed plan reserve
capital_bridge.basis: September30 other-warrant weighted strike $12.53. Q3 EPS footnote reports only 2 incremental Series B common equivalents, not 79,246 common shares; weighted EPS is not a current capitalization or liquidation-rights reconciliation. Dec17 reserve vote is not actual issuance; evergreen starts2028. Instrument-level options/warrants need vesting, strike and exercise treatment.

capital_bridge.label: Subsequent restricted-share compensation
capital_bridge.value: $300,000 aggregate stated award value; count not supplied
capital_bridge.basis: Nov2 8-K: two former directors each to receive $150,000 restricted common, vesting six months after agreement effectiveness. Reconcile grant/issuance dates and counts against cover shares before adding. This is distinct from the proposed +2M plan reserve. Another former director receives $120,000 cash.

capital_bridge.label: ATM capacity
capital_bridge.basis: Potential future sale capacity, not cash or committed financing. New shares depend on actual sales, net price and fees. No current full-dilution denominator established. Ownership exercise blockers on prefunded holdings do not remove economic claims.

capital_bridge.label: Cash: obligations versus legal restriction
capital_bridge.basis: Liquidity section says customer prepayments are expected to fund infrastructure. Reviewed statements do not separately label restricted cash; no quantified legal cash restriction established. Economic delivery obligations do not prove all cash is legally restricted, and reported cash does not prove excess distributable cash. No simple subtraction of contract liabilities from cash.

capital_bridge.label: Seller financing and other funding claims
capital_bridge.basis: Seller payments $0.715M monthly; unpaid balance due Sep30 2027 OR earlier cluster-secured refinancing. No stated seller coupon;17.71% is imputed accounting rate. Refinance proceeds first have to satisfy the existing secured claim. Separate recognized leases $29.906360M and uncommenced lease commitments $407.4M; do not double-count overlapping capex/leases.

capital_bridge.label: Amended Georgia contract revenue
capital_bridge.value: $364.6M expected over five years; $72.92M/year only if evenly spread
capital_bridge.basis: October5 issuer estimate, not realized revenue or scheduled billing. Arithmetic even spread $364.6M/5=$72.92M/year, $18.23M/quarter; replaces reliance on the original $21M/quarter under three years. Neither level cadence nor commencement verified. The release claims improved margin but gives no numerical gross margin.

capital_bridge.label: Georgia counterparty and cost allocation
capital_bridge.value: Axe → Duos Edge AI → Meta 1; direct Meta 1 contract terminated October
capital_bridge.basis: Q3 risk factor identifies Duos as reseller and site/power cost-bearer for five years; Duos group also holds seller security. Axe has no direct contractual recourse against Meta1. Costs covered by Duos depend on its performance, not zero-risk/zero-cost infrastructure. These named parties do not identify anonymous Q3 revenue Customers A/B.

capital_bridge.label: Operating partner and asset consumption
capital_bridge.value: $20.8M Penguin five-year fees; $366.7M property/equipment in construction
capital_bridge.basis: Note15 Penguin fees paid at cluster completion and first four anniversaries; allocate by project before claiming Georgia margin. 10-Q illustrates annual depreciation $73.3M at five years or $52.4M at seven years on all $366.7M if in service and no residual. Depreciation is not replacement cash capex; owned GPU renewal economics must still enter common cash flow.

capital_bridge.label: Observed trading anchor
capital_bridge.basis: Provider-reported 16:00 EST regular-session snapshot, opened Nov26. Not an executable quote, bid/ask, guaranteed liquidity or a current valuation denominator. $6.63 × historical partial21.370476M=$141.686256M is illustrative economic exposure, not verified current market cap. Provider basic-market-cap headline omits this broader share basis.

decision.new_position: Research stance: wait for accepted service plus a credible gross-profit-to-common-cash bridge before treating the signed portfolio as investable value. At the observed $6.63 close, the illustrative five-year,20%,zero-terminal hurdle is about $47.38M annual common cash using only the historical partial share floor. This is a hurdle, not a forecast or a buy/sell target. A smaller speculative entry still requires an executable quote, loss budget and explicit event-risk acceptance.
decision.existing_holding: Re-underwrite expected per-share cash today. Do not rely on the stale $21M quarterly Georgia forecast, basic-only share count, token-driven GAAP profits or cash as liquidation surplus. Monitor Dec17 equity-plan vote and actual grants separately; determine whether the position can withstand further acceptance/funding uncertainty without needing an immediate exit in limited liquidity.
decision.upgrade: Dated acceptance and service evidence; amended revenue schedule and numerical Build margins; funding through deployment and seller repayment; same-date economic securities reconciliation; credible cash available to common after hardware renewal and all obligations. Duos payment/performance evidence improves the concentrated counterparty case.
decision.downgrade: Failed acceptance, explicit timetable deterioration, customer/contract impairment, unexpected burden of power/colocation costs, funding that impairs per-share cash, or material dilution not accompanied by sufficient incremental common value. Silence before March31 2027 is not automatically a missed revised window.

gaps: No defensible five-year company common-cash-flow forecast or residual hardware/common-equity value; scenarios intentionally empty. Hurdles do not estimate fair value.

The September30 share floor omits options/other warrants and is historical; full current security rights, exercises, sales and preferred liquidation/conversion terms remain to reconcile. Q3 diluted EPS2 preferred shares is useful evidence but not a definitive current rights schedule.
No segregated legally restricted-cash amount or complete future customer/vendor/capex/refund funding bridge established. Economic use commitments must not be mislabeled legal restrictions.

Georgia expected $364.6M lifetime revenue has no verified cadence or numerical gross margin. $72.92M even-spread revenue is not common cash flow and must not be compared as if equivalent to the hurdle.
Penguin fees are multi-cluster; deployment capex, lease commitments and service costs need project allocation and overlap checks. Duos cost coverage depends on credit/performance.

Next results date and later acceptance not verified by this focused document review; no exhaustive Nov26 filing sweep claimed. Public sources only; no internal employer or relationship information used.

This November26 sheet supersedes the November25 brief’s statement that amended Georgia lifetime economics were wholly unreconciled: the public October5 release gives $364.6M lifetime revenue. The prior brief remains a dated research snapshot; quarterly cadence, numerical margin and common cash flow remain unknown.

hurdle.title: What annual cash would common shareholders need?
hurdle.method: Five-year level common cash flow with zero terminal value
hurdle.formula: Annual common cash (USD M) = price (USD/share) × economic shares (M) / sum((1 + r)^(-t), t=1..5). Six-month delay row uses t=1.5..5.5.
hurdle.basis: Analyst hypothetical inverse present-value exercise. Cash is after all corporate/senior claims, cash taxes, working capital, maintenance/replacement/growth capex and financing/lease payments; no separate debt deduction or free-cash addition. Five years is an illustrative horizon, not the company life. Zero terminal is a convention, not a statement that residual assets are worthless. Rates15/20/25% are sensitivities, not estimates of required return.

rows.label: Illustrative price; not a target / 15% return assumption
rows.explanation: Five equal year-end net cash flows available to all economic common claims after all operating, tax, capex, financing, lease and senior obligations; zero terminal value; no excess cash added. Historical partial share basis understates any additional dilution. Discount rate is an analyst assumption, not measured cost of equity.
